finding: Git text normalization changed CRLF source bytes to LF while qualification recorded original raw CRLF hashes. A PowerShell command sequence continued after the Python assertion, so the initial commit/PR was created before correction.
resolution: Explicit per-file byte preservation for the three new source/test files; restage original qualified bytes and require all staged seal/source assertions before committing. Original sealed packet remains unchanged.
reason: Original qualified source content and DLL payload are unchanged; correction preserves the qualified raw bytes in Git.
